profile.headline: Backend developer at Nokia Deepfield
profile.summary: Experienced Machine Learning Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Python, Clojure, Java, and C/C++. Strong engineering professional with a Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) focused in Robotics from Universitat de Girona.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintain and develop backend algorithms for a cloud-based machine learning platform.
• Collaborative software development in Clojure, Java, and Python
• Implement custom machine learning workflows for customers using the BigML platform.

positions.title: Faculty Research Associate, Department of Nuclear Engineering
positions.description:
• Electronics design for an 8-channel FPGA-based digital pulse processor
• Provide electronics support for Consortium for Verification Technology (CVT) projects.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
• Created a Django web application for managing reservations of research and conference facilities
• Migrated existing database from previous Visual Fox Pro + PHP solution.

positions.title: Student Researcher, Department of Nuclear Engineering
positions.description:
• Developed FPGA firmware for a digital Beta-Gamma particle detector.
• Created a wxPython GUI for the same detection system.
• Handled small amounts of radioactive isotopes.

positions.title: DAAD Summer Intern, Faculty of Electrical Power Systems
positions.description:
• Designed and documented a LabVIEW data acquisition system for a doubly-fed induction gen-
erator demonstration rig.
• Troubleshooted high power systems.
• Translated German research publications into English.

positions.title: NREIP Summer Intern, Space Sciences Division
